description: This file defines the `OmiProxy` class, which inherits from the `IOmiProxy` interface. It provides method declarations related to mounting and unmounting encrypted bundles and managing listeners, with placeholder implementations. The file serves as an interface/abstract class header for the OMI proxy functionality.
